classification_contract.applicable_unchanged: The pinned module must run without edits against the installed wheel.
classification_contract.external_unavailable: Execution requires an unavailable external ecosystem or service.
classification_contract.not_applicable: The module does not test or demonstrate the supported release contract.
classification_contract.platform_substituted: The workload is relevant but requires a documented non-CUDA execution substitution.
classification_contract.unreviewed: No release claim may be derived until this entry is reviewed.

evidence: Pinned source: curobo/examples/__init__.py is an empty package marker with no executable workload.
entries.rationale: Package initialization alone does not test or demonstrate a release behavior.
